description: This file implements the HeartbeatProcedure class and related classes for managing heartbeat signals in a server context, including factory creation, handling ping events, and cleanup logic.

classes.name: firebolt::rialto::server::HeartbeatProcedure
classes.description: Main class managing heartbeat signals, including creation of handlers, tracking pings sent, and cleanup.

classes.name: firebolt::rialto::server::HeartbeatProcedure::HeartbeatHandler
classes.description: Nested class handling individual heartbeat ping events, success/failure, and reporting back to the main procedure.

methods.name: firebolt::rialto::server::IHeartbeatProcedureFactory::createFactory
methods.description: Creates a new factory instance for heartbeat procedures.

methods.name: firebolt::rialto::server::HeartbeatProcedureFactory::createHeartbeatProcedure
methods.description: Creates a new HeartbeatProcedure instance with specified ack sender and ping ID.

methods.name: firebolt::rialto::server::HeartbeatProcedure::createHandler
methods.description: Creates a new heartbeat handler for a specific control ID.

methods.name: firebolt::rialto::server::HeartbeatProcedure::onStart
methods.description: Marks the start of a ping for a given control ID.

methods.name: firebolt::rialto::server::HeartbeatProcedure::onFinish
methods.description: Handles the completion of a ping, updating success status.
